title: Battery Voltage Monitoring
text: 电池电压监测，输入 2 路、输出 3 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Undervoltage limit (V)} 指定欠压限值、{Overvoltage limit (V)} 指定过压限值、{Voltage sensor fault threshold (V)} 指定电压传感器故障阈值、{Qualification time undervoltage (s)} 指定欠压确认时间、{Disqualification time undervoltage (s)} 指定欠压取消确认时间、{Qualification time overvoltage (s)} 指定过压确认时间、{Disqualification time overvoltage (s)} 指定过压取消确认时间、{Qualification time faulty sensor (s)} 指定传感器故障确认时间、{Disqualification time faulty sensor (s)} 指定传感器故障取消确认时间、{Algorithm data type} 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit，按实例取值。

params.name: Voltage sensor fault threshold (V)
params.values: 电压传感器故障阈值 0.25 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Qualification time undervoltage (s)
params.values: 欠压确认时间 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Disqualification time undervoltage (s)
params.values: 欠压取消确认时间 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Qualification time overvoltage (s)
params.values: 过压确认时间 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Disqualification time overvoltage (s)
params.values: 过压取消确认时间 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Qualification time faulty sensor (s)
params.values: 传感器故障确认时间 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Disqualification time faulty sensor (s)
params.values: 传感器故障取消确认时间 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive integer

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
